about: The CUPTI counters of EnergyProbes, in one place: the program collects every name here (CounterTable.cpp) and
the Python tools read them through counter_table.py. A counter feeds model events ('feeds') or is a check
('use'). 'alias_of': the same counter under another chip's name (stored under the canonical name).
'alternative': a different counter that a GPU has instead (fp16 on its own pipe or inside the fma pipe).
'group': an optional group of counters that older runs lack; then its events are counted with their pipe.
'optional': true for a counter that only some chips have and whose absence is normal (the events are then counted
'min_cc': the lowest compute capability that can have the counter (the program does not ask older GPUs for it).
'exists': where it was found (Nsight Compute 2025.2.1 metric lists, tools/check_chip_metrics.py).

counters.name: l1tex__t_sector_hit_rate.pct
counters.use: level check: share of L1 sectors that hit (check_run.py)

counters.name: lts__t_sectors_op_read.sum
counters.use: level check: L2 sectors of all sources (check_run.py)

counters.name: lts__t_sectors_op_write.sum
counters.use: level check: L2 sectors of all sources (check_run.py)

counters.name: lts__t_requests_srcunit_tex_op_atom_lookup_miss.sum
counters.feeds: L2 read miss request, L2 partial write miss request

counters.name: lts__t_requests_srcunit_tex_op_red_lookup_miss.sum
counters.feeds: L2 read miss request, L2 partial write miss request

counters.name: dram__sectors_write.sum
counters.feeds: DRAM write sector, L2 partial write miss request

counters.name: dram__sectors_op_read.sum
counters.exists: GB202 (RTX 5090): the DRAM sectors under this name, untested

counters.name: dram__sectors_op_write.sum
counters.exists: GB202 (RTX 5090): the DRAM sectors under this name, untested

counters.name: l1tex__data_bank_reads.sum
counters.use: check: reads of the L1/shared data banks; a broadcast shared load reads only its distinct words (the optional broadcast probes, 2026-11-18); global loads read banks too

counters.name: idc__requests_lookup_miss_tag_miss.sum
counters.note: not idc__requests_lookup_hit: it is requests minus lookup misses, and a miss that finds no free tag is replayed and looked up again, so on an RTX 3090 it came out negative

counters.name: smsp__thread_inst_executed.sum
counters.feeds: inst inactive lanes (with smsp__inst_executed.sum: 32 x warp instructions minus thread instructions; predicated-off lanes count as active)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_alu.sum
counters.feeds: inst alu (warp count; lanes from sm__thread_..._alu_pred_on)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_fma_type_fp16.sum
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (fp16 inside the fma pipe; taken out of inst fma)
counters.exists: GA10x and newer: fp16 inside the fma pipe

counters.name: sm__thread_inst_executed_pipe_fma_type_fp16_pred_on.sum
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (active lanes; fp16 inside the fma pipe)
counters.exists: GA10x and newer: fp16 inside the fma pipe

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_fp16.sum
counters.exists: Volta, Turing, GA100: fp16 on a pipe of its own
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (fp16 on a pipe of its own; taken out of inst other)

counters.name: sm__thread_inst_executed_pipe_fp16_pred_on.sum
counters.exists: Volta, Turing, GA100: fp16 on a pipe of its own
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (active lanes; fp16 on a pipe of its own)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor_op_hmma_type_hfma2.sum
counters.feeds: inst fp16 (HFMA2.MMA run on the tensor pipe; taken out of inst tensor)
counters.exists: GA100, GH100 (ptxas emits HFMA2.MMA also in kernels without MMA); not on GA102, AD102, GB100, GB202

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor_op_imma.sum
counters.feeds: inst tensor imma (IMMA, the integer matrix products; taken out of inst tensor)
counters.exists: TU102, GA100, GA102, AD102, GH100; GB100, GB202 as tensor_subpipe_imma

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor_subpipe_imma.sum
counters.exists: GB100, GB202: the IMMA count under this name

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor_op_dmma.sum
counters.feeds: inst fp64 (DMMA counted on the tensor pipe; taken out of inst tensor)
counters.exists: GA100, GH100; on GA102, AD102, GB202 DMMA is part of the fp64 pipe (pipe_fp64_op_dmma)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor_subpipe_dmma.sum
counters.feeds: inst fp64 (DMMA on the tensor sub-pipe; taken out of inst tensor)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tc.sum
counters.use: check: Blackwell 5th-gen MMA (tcgen05, UTC*MMA, one thread issues); no probe prices it, a kernel that counts it is mispriced

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tmem.sum
counters.use: check: tensor-memory loads and stores (tcgen05.ld/st); no probe prices them

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor_op_gmma.sum
counters.use: check: Hopper WGMMA (4 warp instructions per logical MMA, operands from shared memory); inside the tensor pipe, so priced as HMMA until a WGMMA probe exists

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tma.sum
counters.use: check: TMA (bulk copies between global and shared memory); no probe prices it

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_op_stas.sum
counters.use: check: stores to distributed shared memory (clusters); no probe prices them

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_op_redas.sum
counters.use: check: reductions on distributed shared memory (clusters); no probe prices them

counters.name: lts__t_sectors_srcunit_ltcfabric.sum
counters.use: check: L2 sectors that crossed between L2 partitions (far L2); the L2 price averages near and far

counters.name: lrc__ilc_output_sectors.sum
counters.use: check: inline compression output; must stay 0 (default allocations are not compressible)

counters.name: smsp__inst_executed_pipe_uniform.sum
counters.use: check: the uniform datapath (ULDC, LDCU, ...), counted inside inst other

counters.name: lts__cycles_elapsed.avg.per_second
counters.use: check: the L2 clock (Hz), which may differ from the SM clock and between runs

counters.name: gpu__time_duration.sum
counters.use: the kernel's GPU time per launch (ns): --validate and --tune take it as the kernel time, since KTT's time per launch includes its NVML hook (about 0.6 ms on an RTX 3090; EnergyTuner.h, CounterKernelS)

counters.name: l1tex__data_pipe_lsu_wavefronts_mem_lg_cmd_read.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): L1 data-stage wavefronts of global and local loads

counters.name: l1tex__data_pipe_lsu_wavefronts_mem_lg_cmd_write.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): L1 data-stage wavefronts of global and local stores

counters.name: l1tex__t_set_accesses_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): L1 tag-set lookups of global loads

counters.name: l1tex__t_set_accesses_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_st.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): L1 tag-set lookups of global stores

counters.name: l1tex__t_sectors_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld_lookup_miss.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): L1 sectors of global loads that missed

counters.name: l1tex__m_xbar2l1tex_read_sectors.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): sectors returned from L2 to L1

counters.name: dram__cycles_active.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): DRAM cycles with activity

counters.name: sm__cycles_active.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): SM cycles with at least one resident warp, summed over SMs

counters.name: sm__warps_active.sum
counters.use: candidate (2026-11-17): resident warps per cycle, summed over SMs (occupancy)
